messages:
Zoe (Docs): opened a tiny PR to tighten wording on reserved vs burst and add a minimal YAML + CLI example. quick check? https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1588 :wave:
Liam (Runtime): quick callout: use 'eviction' not 'preemption'. keys: eviction_policy (graceful|immediate|delayed) and eviction_priority (low|medium|high). delayed has a cooldown (default 300s).
Aria (CLI): flags are kebab-case: --eviction-priority, --isolation-level. examples should match exactly or tests fail.
Zoe (Docs): current YAML in PR:
```yaml
name: gpu-reserved
min_instances: 2
max_instances: 8
eviction_policy: graceful
eviction_priority: low
isolation_level: node
```
Liam (Runtime): looks good. maybe add a one-line note: isolation_level= gpu pins a whole GPU to the tenant (higher cost).
Carmen (Product): SLA wording: short and linky. Suggest: "Reserved capacity: guaranteed baseline per contract. Burst: best-effort, subject to pool & regional availability." Link to SLA reference.
Zoe (Docs): will use that line and add link to /handbook/enterprise/slas/dedicated.md. redwood-docs-bot: CI link check: found /handbook/enterprise/slas/dedicated.md OK.
Aria (CLI): once you push updates ping me; I'll run the CLI smoke test on the example flags.
Zoe (Docs): thanks all, pushing fixes (kebab flags, add gpu note, SLA line). ping if anything else.
Liam (Runtime): quick LGTM from me after fixes.
Carmen (Product): will do a brief review post-update.
